To take advantage of this particular offer now, apply through the method provided in this advertisement. Review offer details before you apply.This credit card is not available to either (i) current cardmembers of any personal IHG One Rewards Credit Card, or (ii) previous cardmembers of any personal IHG One Rewards Credit Card who received a new cardmember bonus for any personal IHG One Rewards Credit Card within the last 24 months.New Cardmember Bonus – 140,000 Points: To qualify, you must make $3,000 in purchases during the first 3 months from account opening. After qualifying, please allow 6 to 8 weeks for bonus to post to your IHG One Rewards account. To be eligible for this bonus offer, your credit card account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. Purchases are when you, or an authorized user, use a card to make purchases of products and services. However, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account-funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. Chase may close your credit card account or suspend your right to use your credit card account, at any time for any reason, including account inactivity.10,000 Bonus Points After You Add An Authorized User In The First 3 Months From Account Opening: You will qualify and receive 10,000 bonus points after your addition of an authorized user to your account during the first 3 months from account opening. 10,000 bonus points will only be awarded once, for the first authorized user added to your account regardless of how many total authorized users you add to your account. After qualifying, please allow 6 to 8 weeks for bonus points to post to your account. To be eligible for this bonus offer, account must be open and not in default, and authorized user must be on your account at the time of fulfillment.Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits and services. Bonus rewards will post directly to your partner loyalty program account and will not appear on your credit card statement.Adding Authorized Users: All correspondence, including credit cards, statements, and notifications will be sent to the name and address on file for the primary cardmember. The primary cardmember is responsible for repaying all balances on this account. Authorized users will have the same charging privileges as the primary cardmember but will not be financially responsible. Chase provides account information to the credit reporting agencies for all account users. This information could impact an authorized user’s credit score. When you tell us to add a user to your account, you’re confirming that you have a relationship with the person or people whose name(s), address(es), and date(s) of birth you’ve told us, that all their information is correct, and that you have their consent to add them. If Chase determines you’ve given us fraudulent name, address, or date of birth information or did not have such consent, Chase can close this account.Earning in the Rewards Program: You’ll earn points on purchases of products and services, minus returns or refunds, made with an IHG One Rewards credit card by you or an authorized user of the account; however, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases and won’t earn points: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account-funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. 10 points ("10X points"): You'll earn 10 points for each $1 spent on qualifying purchases made at hotels participating in IHG One Rewards. Go to ihg.com/terms, as applicable, for a list of hotels participating in IHG One Rewards. You will only receive the accelerated earn of 10 points for each $1 spent from this credit card program. IHG One Rewards is responsible for ensuring all hotels participating in IHG One Rewards are correctly reported to Chase for earn on IHG One Rewards credit card purchases. Additional points received under the IHG One Rewards program for stays at hotels participating in IHG One Rewards will be earned in accordance with the IHG One Rewards Membership Terms and Conditions. 5 points (“5X points”): You’ll earn 5 points for each $1 spent on purchases made in the following rewards categories: grocery stores; gas stations; dining at restaurants including takeout and eligible delivery services. 5 points (“5X points”) by 12/31: You’ll earn 5 points for each $1 spent on purchases that post to your account through December 31, 2026 in the travel rewards category (excluding purchases made at hotels participating in IHG One Rewards that qualify for 10 points as described above). Purchases posted to your account after December 31, 2026 will earn 5 points for each $1 spent only in the following travel rewards categories: airline tickets when purchased directly with the airline; and car rental agencies. All other travel purchases will earn 3 points for each $1 spent. Delays by the merchant could extend the transaction date beyond December 31, 2026, making some travel purchases ineligible to earn 5x points. 3 points (“3X points”): You’ll earn 3 points for each $1 spent on all other purchases. Information about earning/transferring points to IHG One Rewards: Points earned during a billing cycle are automatically transferred to IHG One Rewards after the end of each billing cycle. Points expiration: The points transferred to your IHG One Rewards account will not expire as long as there is IHG One Rewards program activity for 12 consecutive months, depending on your status. IHG One Rewards Membership terms and conditions apply. For complete program details, visit ihg.com/terms. Losing points: You'll immediately lose all points that haven't been transferred to IHG One Rewards if your card account status changes, or your card account is closed for program misuse, fraudulent activities, or other reasons described in the terms of the Rewards Program Agreement. For important information about Chase rewards categories, see chase.com/RewardsCategoryFAQs. For more information about the IHG One Rewards Premier card rewards program, you can see the latest Rewards Program Agreement at chase.com/ihgonerewardspremiercard/rewardsagreement and it will also be available for cardmembers after logging in to chase.com and will be mailed for new or changed accounts.Earning Points from IHG on Stays: IHG One Rewards members earn on qualifying stays and eligible charges at IHG® Hotels and Resorts in the following manner: Members earn 10 points per $1 spent and Gold Elite members earn an additional 4 points per $1 spent (40% bonus), except at Candlewood Suites® and Staybridge Suites® where members earn 5 points per $1 spent and Gold Elite members earn an additional 2 points per $1 spent (40% bonus), IHG® Army Hotels where members earn 3 points per $1 spent and Gold Elite members earn an additional 1.2 points per $1 spent (40% bonus), and IHG® Residence properties where members earn 2.5 points per $1 spent and Gold Elite members earn an additional 1 points per $1 spent (40% bonus). All point deposits will be totaled and rounded to the nearest whole number. Stays must be booked on a direct IHG® booking channel such as ihg.com in order to qualify. Points earned with your IHG One Rewards membership and Elite status will post directly to your IHG One Rewards account and will not appear on your Chase credit card statement. For complete program details, visit ihg.com/terms.Gold Elite Status: You qualify for automatic IHG One Rewards Gold Elite status for as long as you remain a Premier credit cardmember, and as long as your IHG One Rewards membership account remains in good standing. Please allow 6 to 8 weeks after account opening for the automatic Elite status to be applied to your IHG One Rewards account.Anniversary Free Night: Anniversary Free Night will be available for redemption on your account anniversary date each year. “Account anniversary date” is the date that is 12 months after your account open date, and the same date each 12 months thereafter. Your Anniversary Free Night will be valid at IHG® Hotels with a point redemption value of 50,000 points or less (covers one standard room night and tax only), with the ability to add on points from your IHG One Rewards account to redeem your Anniversary Free Night at hotels above your point redemption level. Anniversary Free Night must be redeemed, and stay must be completed, within 12 months from date of issue. Visit ihg.com to view current redemption rates. You are responsible for all incidental charges such as parking fees, and payment of mandatory resort fees at properties where resort fees are charged. Rooms are limited, subject to prior sale and availability of allocated resources and may be unavailable during high demand periods. All reservations that will utilize the Anniversary Free Night can be booked online at ihg.com or by calling IHG One Rewards at 1-877-318-5890. Anniversary Free Night may not be transferred, extended beyond the expiration date, redeemed for cash, or re-credited for points. Individual hotel's cancellation policy applies to the use of the Anniversary Free Night. Cancellation fees apply if cancellation is made outside of the hotel's cancellation time period. Anniversary Free Night rules and regulations are subject to change. To receive Anniversary Free Night communications, members must maintain a valid email address in the IHG One Rewards member profile and opt in to receive IHG One Rewards e-communications. Chase is not responsible for offer fulfillment.Elite Night Credits each year: You, as the primary cardmember, will receive 15 Elite Night Credits (“ENC”) in your IHG One Rewards account within 6-8 weeks upon opening your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card from Chase®. After that, the 15 ENCs will be deposited into your IHG One Rewards account by February 1 each calendar year. To qualify for ENCs, your credit card account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment, your IHG One Rewards account must be active and in good standing in accordance with the IHG One Rewards Program Terms & Conditions, available at ihg.com/terms. ENCs will be counted for purposes of determining Elite membership status and Milestone Rewards under the IHG One Rewards program. For more information on Elite Status, the associated benefits and achieving the different tiers visit IHG One Rewards Membership Terms and Conditions at ihg.com/terms. Chase is not responsible for offer fulfillment or the provision of or failure to provide the stated benefits and service.2 Elite Night Credits for Every $5,000 Spent: You, as the primary cardmember, will earn 2 Elite Night Credits for each $5,000 spent in purchases. Purchases are when you, or an authorized user, use a card to make purchases of products and services; however, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. We reserve the right to change or end this offer at any time. There is no limit to the number of Elite Night Credits that you can earn. Please allow 6-8 weeks for Elite Nights to be posted to your IHG One Rewards account. To qualify for the Elite Night Credits, your account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. Only Elite Night Credits earned within a given calendar year will count toward status for the same year. Chase is not responsible for offer fulfillment or the provision of or failure to provide the stated benefits and services. For more information on Elite Status, the associated benefits and achieving the different tiers visit IHG One Rewards Membership Terms and Conditions at ihg.com/terms.$15,000 Annual Spend benefits: You, as the primary cardmember, will qualify for Platinum Elite Status, 5 Elite Night credits and 15,000 bonus points after spending $15,000 in purchases with your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card each calendar year. Purchases are when you, or an authorized user, use a card to make purchases of products and services; however, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. Calendar year means January 1 through December 31 of that same year. Delays by the merchant could extend the transaction date. Purchases posted to your account with a transaction date after December 31 will count toward the following year’s spend requirement. After qualifying, please allow 6-8 weeks for these benefits to post to your account. To qualify for these benefits, your credit card account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. Platinum Elite Status: After meeting the $15,000 spend requirement, you will qualify for IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status for the remainder of the calendar year in which you qualify and the following calendar year. To maintain Platinum Elite Status your account must be open and not in default. If you do not qualify for this offer, in order to receive Platinum Elite benefits you must qualify for Platinum Elite Status under the terms of the IHG One Rewards program. Only one IHG One Rewards Credit Card account per IHG One Rewards member is eligible for the Platinum Elite Status award. 5 Elite Night Credits: After meeting the $15,000 spend requirement, you will qualify for 5 Elite Night Credits for purposes of determining Elite membership status and Milestone Rewards under the IHG One Rewards program. For more information on Elite Status, the associated benefits and achieving the different tiers visit IHG One Rewards Membership Terms and Conditions at ihg.com/terms. Chase is not responsible for the provision of or failure to provide Elite Night Credits and the Platinum Elite Status benefits and services.Up to $100 in Annual IHG Food & Beverage Rewards: You, as the primary credit cardmember, will receive one Food & Beverage Reward voucher of up to $25 each calendar quarter (January - March; April - June; July - September; October - December), up to a total of $100 in IHG One Rewards Food & Beverage Rewards per calendar year, to be redeemed for credit against eligible food and beverage on your room bill at participating IHG Hotels & Resorts. Each voucher is valid for the quarter in which it was issued, with an expiration date at the end of the issuing quarter. For example, a voucher issued in the first quarter of the year (January 1st) will expire on the last day of the quarter (March 31st). Each voucher can only be used once, even if your applicable charges total less than $25. If the full $25 value is not used, the remaining value will be forfeited. Eligible charges vary by property but generally include food, beverage (including alcoholic beverages), and gratuities and must be captured on the primary cardmember’s room bill. The room reservation must be made under the primary cardmember’s name for charges to be billed to them. Whether a specific charge is eligible will be determined solely by the participating property. IHG Food & Beverage Rewards are not applicable to vending machines, third-party food and beverage deliveries, restaurants that do not allow charges to a guest room bill, gift shop purchases, taxes associated to minibar charges, and taxes. Vouchers are non-transferable and may only be applied to charges on a single room during a stay. There is no limit to the number of Food & Beverage Rewards you can use per stay on one room. Food & Beverage Rewards have no cash value and must be available in your IHG One Rewards account for redemption. Participating IHG Hotels & Resorts include all IHG brands except IHG Army Hotels and select Six Senses locations. The IHG Food & Beverage Rewards are also not available at Iberostar Beachfront Resorts, Royal Resorts by Holiday Inn Club Vacations, or at InterContinental Alliance Resorts (Macau). Once redeemed, Food & Beverage Rewards will not be reversed or refunded. Charges that are paid using Food & Beverage Rewards will not earn IHG One Rewards points. The $25 value will be converted to the property’s local currency at the time of redemption based on the prevailing exchange rate determined by IHG. Food & Beverage Rewards cannot be applied to charges incurred during a stay as part of a group, package tour, or convention. Each $25 voucher will be automatically posted each quarter in your Member’s Rewards Wallet for as long as you remain an IHG One Rewards Premier credit cardmember, and as long as your IHG One Rewards membership account remains in good standing, in accordance with IHG One Rewards terms and conditions (visit ihg.com/terms). Chase is not responsible for offer fulfillment or the provision of or failure to provide the stated benefits and services.$100 Annual Statement Credit on flights booked with the airline through 12/31/27: A one-time statement credit of $100 per calendar year will automatically be applied to your account when you make a purchase of at least $250 with your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card on flight tickets booked directly with the airline through 12/31/27. Calendar year means January 1 through December 31 of that same year. Processing delays can cause purchases made during the current calendar year to count toward the following year’s statement credit. Statement credits should post to your account within 3 business days but may take up to 4 weeks. We may reverse statement credits if an eligible purchase is returned, canceled, or modified or if you close your account within 90 days of receiving a statement credit. To receive statement credits, your card account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. For important information about Chase rewards categories, see chase.com/RewardsCategoryFAQs.Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® or NEXUS Application Fee Statement CreditYou will receive one statement credit every four years (up to $120) after the first program (either Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® or NEXUS) application fee is charged to your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card, by you or an authorized user. This benefit applies only to the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck® or NEXUS programs, other Trusted Traveler Programs are not eligible. Only purchases made directly with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, eligible partner listed on ttp.cbp.dhs.gov/, or authorized enrollment providers featured on tsa.gov/precheck website are eligible for reimbursement. Purchases made through any third parties, such as travel agencies or application assistance services, are not eligible for reimbursement. The statement credit will appear on your credit card billing statement within 1-2 billing cycles. You are responsible for payment of all charges until the statement credit posts to the account. Chase has no control or liability regarding these programs including, but not limited to, applications, approval process or enrollment, or fees charged by CBP or TSA or DHS. For more information about the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck® and NEXUS programs, including application details and full terms and conditions, go to ttp.cbp.dhs.gov/. Websites and other information provided by government agencies are not within Chase's control and may not be available in Spanish. To receive statement credits, your account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment.TSA PreCheck® is a registered trademark and is used with the permission of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.Complimentary DashPass: When the membership is activated for the first time with your eligible Chase card between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2027, you will receive 12 months of complimentary DashPass for use on both the DoorDash and Caviar applications during the same membership period based on the first activation date. After the complimentary DashPass membership period ends, you will continue to be enrolled and will be automatically charged the then-current monthly DashPass rate (plus applicable tax) on a recurring monthly basis for each membership activated until you cancel. You can cancel anytime on DoorDash or Caviar. The same log in credentials must be used on DoorDash and Caviar in order for the DashPass benefit to be used on both applications. To receive the membership benefits, the cardmember must first add their applicable Chase credit card as a default payment method on DoorDash or Caviar, and then click the activation button. Once enrolled in DashPass, you must use your eligible Chase card for payment at checkout for DashPass-eligible orders to receive DashPass benefits. DashPass benefits apply only to eligible orders from DashPass-eligible merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement (as stated in the DoorDash and Caviar apps and sites with amounts subject to change). However, other fees (including service fee), taxes, and gratuity on orders may apply. Current value of the DashPass membership is as of 02/01/2025. DashPass orders are subject to delivery driver and geographic availability. Membership must be activated with a United States address. Payment through third-party payment accounts, or online or mobile digital wallets (like Apple Pay and Google Wallet), or memberships purchased through third parties are excluded from this offer. If you product change to another Chase credit card during the promotional period, your benefits may change. You may experience a delay in updating your applicable benefits on DoorDash or Caviar; please note, once you product trade, the benefits from your previous credit card are no longer available for your use. You can only access the benefits available with your current credit card. Mobile applications, websites and other information provided by DoorDash or Caviar are not within Chase’s control and may or may not be available in Spanish. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or the failure to provide, DoorDash or Caviar benefits and services. Your applicable Chase credit card account must be open and not in default to maintain membership benefits. See full DoorDash terms and conditions at: https://help.doordash.com/consumers/s/article/offer-terms-conditions?language=en_US.Earn Up to $10 Off Monthly or Quarterly on DoorDash Non-Restaurant Orders: Once you have activated your DashPass membership for the first time between 09/01/2026 and 12/31/2027, you will receive a $10 off discount each calendar month at checkout on one qualifying non-restaurant order on DoorDash as long as you remain enrolled in a DashPass membership. If you activated your DashPass membership between 02/01/2025 and 08/31/2026, you will receive a $10 off discount each calendar quarter at checkout on one qualifying non-restaurant order on DoorDash as long as you remain enrolled in a DashPass membership. Please visit your Manage DashPass page to check when you activated your DashPass membership and confirm which discount applies to your account. Discount applies to subtotal only; does not apply to fees, taxes, and gratuity. Fees, taxes, and gratuity still apply. To claim, select the discount from the promotion wallet at checkout, or claim the discount when prompted in the DoorDash app or website. If the full $10 value is not used on a single order, the remaining value will be forfeited. You must use the card used to enroll in your DashPass membership as your payment method at order checkout to receive this discount. This discount may be combined with other order-level promotions, discounts, or deals. The discount will be made available to you in your DoorDash account at the beginning of each month or quarter and will only be available on that platform for the remainder of that calendar month or quarter; the discount will not roll over into a subsequent month or quarter. Once redeemed, the discount will not be refunded to the user regardless of whether the user otherwise receives a refund or credits back on their order. Not valid for the purchase of gift cards. Limit one redemption per month or quarter per person. Merchant and brand exclusions may apply. For orders containing alcohol, the promotional discount is subject to restrictions based on applicable laws. Valid in the U.S. only. Discount has no cash value and is non-transferable. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or the failure to provide, DoorDash benefits and services. Credit card product changes during the promotional period will forfeit this offer. Additional DoorDash promotional terms and conditions available at: https://help.doordash.com/consumers/s/article/offer-terms-conditions?language=en_US.All deliveries subject to availability. Must have or create a valid DoorDash account. Qualifying orders containing alcohol will be charged a $0.01 Delivery Fee. No cash value. Non-transferable. See full terms and conditions at: help.doordash.com/consumers/s/article/offer-terms-conditions.Receive one $10 credit per month in the Instacart App: As an IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card Primary cardmember, you can receive one $10 credit in your Instacart account each month you have an active Instacart+ membership after you activate your complimentary Chase Instacart+ membership using your eligible Chase credit card on https://www.instacart.com/p/chase-cobrands from 5/1/2025 through 12/31/2027. The monthly credit will be made available to you in your Instacart+ account at the beginning of each month and will only be available on that platform for the remainder of that calendar month; the monthly credit will not roll over into a subsequent month. Each monthly credit is only eligible on one purchase of $10 or more made on Instacart.com with one retailer using your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card. Any unused portion of a monthly credit will not be available for future use. Eligible purchases will qualify for this credit the month your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card is added to your Instacart account and each month thereafter. To qualify for this credit, your IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. If your credit card account is closed at any time, Instacart and Chase reserve the right to remove any unused Instacart credits from your account. Credit will be applied to the total purchase price for all eligible products and excludes taxes, service and delivery fees, tips, special handling fees and/or other fees. Limit 1 credit per order. Excludes restaurant orders powered by Uber Eats. State and Local laws in your area may prohibit alcohol discounts and/or exclude alcohol from this offer’s qualifying minimum spend of $10. If the discount isn’t applied automatically during checkout, alcohol products may not be eligible for this offer in your location. Credit has no cash value and is non-transferable. Mobile applications, websites and other information provided by Instacart are not within Chase’s control and may or may not be available in Spanish. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or the failure to provide, Instacart benefits and services. Credit card product changes during the promotional period will forfeit this offer. Deliveries subject to availability. In order to take advantage of this offer, customers must have a valid account on Instacart.com with their valid IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card on file. Only one offer per household. Instacart reserves the right to modify or cancel this offer at any time. Offer may not be sold, copied, modified, transferred or used retroactively for prior purchases. Void where restricted or prohibited by law. Offer may expire prior to your actual use of the offer, without liability to Instacart. Instacart is not a retailer or seller. Instacart may not be available in all zip or post codes.Up to $50 United® Airlines TravelBank Cash Each Year: Must be an IHG One Rewards Premier Select or Premier cardmember to be eligible for this benefit. Each calendar year, the primary cardmember will receive one $25 United® TravelBank cash deposit in their United MileagePlus® account on or about January 5, and another $25 United® TravelBank cash deposit on or about July 5, subject to the requirements and restrictions below. Cardmembers must complete a one-time registration to receive this benefit. Registration is available at ihg.com/united. The registration must be made through the Cardmember’s IHG One Rewards account. Only one registration per IHG® account is permitted. If the cardmember is not already a United MileagePlus® member, they must first enroll in the MileagePlus® program on united.com. If a cardmember’s membership in United’s MileagePlus® program is terminated, the cardmember will no longer be eligible to receive this benefit. For complete details about the MileagePlus Program, go to united.com.
